items.title: Around 90 single parents register for govt allowance each month
items.summary: The highest number of new registrations was recorded in July, when 115 single parents joined the scheme.

items.title: ACC seeks prosecution of 4 Addu hospital staff over procurement
items.summary: According to the ACC, the case involves the purchase of micropipette tips at prices exceeding prevailing market rates, in violation of finance regulation.

items.title: Governor says majority of tourism dollars remain outside banks
items.summary: He said the MMA's objective was to ensure that every dollar entering the Maldives passes through the banking system.

items.summary: The agreements cover road development, coastal protection, harbour construction and upgrading, swimming areas, slipways and an office complex.

items.title: Govt targets MVR 2.8B from land sales, transfer fees by 2029
items.summary: The MMA stressed the importance of ensuring that the government's objectives for the sector are achieved.

items.title: DNR report submitted as evidence in case against Thinadhoo mayor
items.summary: The state filed two criminal charges against Saud on 1 September 2026 in connection with the alleged submission of inaccurate population information.

items.title: MMA warns rising domestic poses risks to financial stability
items.summary: The assessment identifies risks associated with government borrowing, debt servicing, expenditure, revenue collection and foreign currency reserves.

items.title: Auditor General recommends reducing salary, subsidy in 2027

items.title: RCC launches MVR 120M bond for Blue Marina View project
items.summary: Dhivehi Investment Partners Private Limited (DIP) is serving as Lead Arranger and Principal Adviser for the issuance.
